name: FindingAction
description: Provides information about an action that occurred for a resource and produced a policy finding.

allOf.description: The type of action that occurred for the affected resource. This value is typically AWS_API_CALL, which indicates that an entity invoked an API operation for the resource.
The invocation details of the API operation that an entity invoked for the affected resource, if the value for the actionType property is AWS_API_CALL.
